fact: The 'shoulder of the rein-holder' — a pair of stars that eclipse each other every few days.
bio: Menkalinan (Beta Aurigae) is a system about 81 light-years away, the second-brightest star in Auriga. Its two nearly identical white stars orbit so closely that they periodically pass in front of one another, dimming the star slightly in a four-day rhythm.
cultural: The name is Arabic for 'the shoulder of the rein-holder' — the charioteer Auriga, who drives across the northern winter sky with the goat Capella on his shoulder.
